Balances.description: Which balance-sheet amounts the ratios use (SPEC-0007 R2). No default: the analyst chooses.

oneOf.description: Balances at the end of the period (`closing`).
Average of the opening and closing balances: (opening + closing) / 2. Needs `opening`.

DayBasis.description: Days in the year for day-based ratios (SPEC-0007 R2). No default: the analyst chooses.

WorkingCapitalBalances.description:
Balance-sheet amounts at one date, in currency units. Every amount is optional: absent or
null means not given.

WorkingCapitalIncome.description:
Flows of the period, in currency units. Every amount is optional: absent or null means not
given, and the ratios that need it are not computed (never taken as zero).

cost_of_sales.description: Cost of sales of the period, in currency units.

purchases.description:
Purchases of goods and services of the period, in currency units, on the same VAT basis
as trade payables.

revenue.description: Revenue of the period, in currency units, on the same VAT basis as trade receivables.

description:
Input of `ratios.working_capital` (version 2). Only `balances` and `day_basis` are
required; each ratio is computed when its own amounts are given (SPEC-0007 R7).

balances.description: Balances used by the ratios: `closing`, or `average` of opening and closing.

closing.description: Balance sheet at the end of the period. Absent or null: no amount given.

income_statement.description: Flows of the period (one year). Absent or null: no flow given.

opening.description:
Balance sheet at the start of the period, used with average balances; not used with
closing balances. Absent with average balances: no ratio is computed.

title: WorkingCapitalInput
